info.name: Resume AI Agent API v1 - Dinesh Babu R
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the Resume AI Agent API. Exposes Dinesh Babu R's resume as a queryable REST API with 10 endpoints covering profile, experience, skills, education, certifications, projects, achievements, and full-text keyword search.

Base URL: {{baseUrl}}
Port: 8081

**Before testing:** Start the Mule application in Anypoint Code Builder (Run Mule Application), then import the local environment.

request.description: Returns API health status, version, owner, and list of all available endpoints.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Status is UP', function() { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.status).to.eql('UP'); });
pm.test('Owner is Dinesh Babu R', function() { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.owner).to.eql('Dinesh Babu R'); });

item.name: Profile
item.description: Get professional profile summary including name, title, contact, and career summary

request.description: Returns Dinesh Babu R's full professional profile: name, title, contact details (email, phone, LinkedIn), 10-year career summary, highlights, industries served, certifications count, current role and employer.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Name is Dinesh Babu R', function() { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.data.name).to.eql('Dinesh Babu R'); });
pm.test('Has contact info', function() { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.data.contact).to.have.property('email'); });

item.name: Experience
item.description: Work experience across 5 companies and 8+ client engagements

request.description: Returns all work experience: V4 Impact (2025-Present), Deloitte (2022-2025), Infosys (2021-2022), Apisero (2020-2021), Accenture (2016-2020). Each entry includes role, period, and client engagements.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Has experience data', function() { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.data).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(json.data.length).to.be.greaterThan(0); });
pm.test('Has meta with totalCompanies', function() { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.meta.totalCompanies).to.eql(5); });

request.description: Filter experience by company: V4 Impact (current). Returns Technical Analyst role at Singapore Food Agency (SFA) Enterprise Licensing Modernization programme.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Company is V4 Impact', function() { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.data[0].company).to.include('V4 Impact'); });

request.description: Filter experience by Deloitte. Returns Consulting Manager/Senior Consultant role with clients: UGI Corporation, Australian Sports Foundation, Coca-Cola Euro Pacific Partners, Sasol, Unilever.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Has Deloitte experience', function() { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.data[0].company).to.include('Deloitte'); });

request.description: Filter experience by Infosys. Returns HSBC CloudHub migration project - migrated 50+ microservices from PCE to CloudHub.
Filter experience by Apisero. Returns Casper Sleep Wholesale Order Fulfilment Platform project.
Filter experience by Accenture. Returns Ross Stores Retail Domain Service Application and Pfizer IT Infrastructure Monitoring projects.
Test the 'not found' response when searching for a company that doesn't exist in the resume.

exec: pm.test('Returns error for unknown company', function() { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('error'); });
pm.test('Suggests available companies', function() { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('suggestion'); });

item.name: Skills
item.description: Technical skills, competencies, platforms, tools, and patterns

request.description: Returns all technical skills categorised by: competencies, integrationPlatforms, apiAndMessaging, apiSecurity, cloudAndInfrastructure, platformAdministration, integrationPatterns, devopsAndCICD, languagesAndTechnologies, toolsAndPlatforms.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Has skills data', function() { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.data).to.have.property('competencies'); pm.expect(json.data).to.have.property('integrationPlatforms'); pm.expect(json.data).to.have.property('apiSecurity'); });
pm.test('Has 34 competencies', function() { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.meta.totalCompetencies).to.eql(34); });

request.description: Returns education background. B.E. Mechatronics Engineering from Kongu Engineering College, Anna University (2016).

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Has education data', function() { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.data).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(json.data.length).to.be.greaterThan(0); });
pm.test('Correct degree', function() { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.data[0].degree).to.include('Mechatronics'); });

item.name: Certifications
item.description: Professional certifications - MuleSoft, Salesforce, AWS, Workato, Anthropic

request.description: Returns all 13 certifications with category grouping. Includes: MuleSoft Platform Architect L1, Salesforce MuleSoft Integration Architect, AWS Cloud Practitioner, Workato Automation Pro I/II/III, Salesforce Agentforce Specialist, Salesforce AI Associate, Anthropic MCP (2x), MuleSoft Developer L1, API Design Associate, Integration & API Associate.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Has certifications', function() { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.data).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(json.data.length).to.be.greaterThan(0); });
pm.test('Has category summary', function() { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.summary).to.have.property('byCategory'); });

item.name: Projects
item.description: Notable client projects with technologies used

request.description: Returns all notable client projects flattened from experience data. Each project includes: company, role, clientName, project, period, description, keyAchievements, and technologies used. 8+ major projects across Singapore Government, FMCG, Energy, Financial Services, and Retail sectors.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Has projects data', function() { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.data).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(json.data.length).to.be.greaterThan(5); });
pm.test('Each project has technologies', function() { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.data[0]).to.have.property('technologies'); });

request.description: Returns all professional awards: Deloitte Client Centricity Award, Deloitte Move the Dot Award, Infosys Glory Award, Apisero Raving Reviews Award, Apisero Star Performer Award, H-1B Visa Nominee, C4E Framework Delivery recognition. Also includes professional interests.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Has achievements data', function() { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.data).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(json.data.length).to.be.greaterThan(0); });
pm.test('Has interests', function() { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.interests).to.be.an('array'); });

item.name: Search
item.description: Full-text keyword search across all resume sections

request.description: Search across all resume sections for the keyword 'MuleSoft'. Returns matching experience, skills, certifications, and achievements with a summary of total matches.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Has keyword in response', function() { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.keyword).to.eql('MuleSoft'); });
pm.test('Has results object', function() { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.results).to.be.an('object'); });
pm.test('Has summary', function() { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.summary).to.have.property('totalCertificationMatches'); });

request.description: Search for 'Salesforce' across all resume sections. Should match Salesforce PSS experience at V4 Impact/SFA, Salesforce certifications (Agentforce Specialist, AI Associate, MuleSoft Integration Architect), and Salesforce skills.
Search for 'CloudHub' - should return V4 Impact SFA experience (CloudHub 2.0 VPC/Private Space), Infosys HSBC CloudHub migration, and CloudHub 2.0 skills.
Search for 'AWS' - returns AWS GCC, CloudWatch, SES experience and AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner certification.
Search for 'Singapore' - returns SFA (Singapore Food Agency) project at V4 Impact and Singapore Government cloud experience.
Search for 'MCP' — matches MCP Server skills, Anthropic MCP certifications (2x), AI Integration Innovation project, and MCP-related experience at V4 Impact.
Search for 'Agentforce' — matches Salesforce Agentforce Specialist certification, Agentforce skills, and AI Integration Innovation project.
Search for 'GovTech' — matches Singapore Government Technology Agency context in the SFA Enterprise Licensing Modernization project at V4 Impact.
Test validation: empty keyword should return an error with an example of how to use the API.

exec: pm.test('Returns error for empty keyword', function() { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('error'); });
pm.test('Provides example', function() { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('example'); });
